description.value: D&L Fishing Charters offers multi-day saltwater fishing trips out of Prince Rupert, BC, targeting trophy Chinook and Coho salmon, halibut, cod, and snapper along the North Coast. The charter vessel 'The Crescent' is a 39-foot west coast cruiser with five bunks, a full galley, and a washroom with shower, making it a liveaboard experience. Captain Dennis Langdale brings over 36 years of local marine expertise and offers a guaranteed-catch policy.
